mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS level and 20d forward returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals labor market deterioration that increases recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Proportion of negative 20d forward returns in UNRATE > 4.0% periods is less than 60% or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) and insufficient monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) signals policy failure, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Proportion of negative 20d returns in joint condition periods is less than 60% or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals supply-side slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, proportion of negative 20d returns when INDPRO < 100 is less than 60% or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand and economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC between HOUST level and 20d forward returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales fall below 680,000 million dollars (RSAFS < 680000), it signals consumer spending contraction that increases recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Proportion of negative 20d returns in RSAFS < 680000 periods is less than 60% or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Weak job growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.5%) combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE increase > 0.1%) signals labor market contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Proportion of negative 20d returns in joint condition periods is less than 60% or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion regimes, strong GDP growth (GDPC1 growth > 2.0%) signals economic momentum, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In early-cycle expansion, proportion of positive 20d returns when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% is less than 60% or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
